images.screen: A — 제례를 고르고 이름에 붉은 줄을 긋는 순간 (제5대 윤재림, 1796년)
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Top-down three-quarter view of a dark lacquered wooden desk at night, lit by a warm oil lamp from the upper left. Filling the left two thirds: an open Korean hanji genealogy ledger, fibrous cream paper with thin ruled column lines, text written vertically right-to-left in black ink; older generation columns on the right are faded brown ink with small vermilion seal stamps, and villagers' names crossed out with a single straight vertical vermilion brush stroke. The current empty column is softly highlighted, a calligraphy brush tipped with red ink hovering over a pale pencil-grey name. Along the bottom band of the ledger, dashed red threads arc from earlier columns into later ones, labelled as arriving debts. On the right, three stacked paper slips form the HUD: stat bars, a grid of six ritual choices with one selected in red, and a row of hanging wooden name tags with one lifted. Muted cream, sepia, ink black, single strong vermilion accent. Korean UI text: "저주 장부", "이번 대의 제례", "붉은 줄을 긋는다". Film grain, soft vignette, painterly realism. Ledger constraints: the family surname is 윤 throughout; the ledger has exactly eight generation columns labelled 초대, 2대, 3대, 4대, 5대, 6대, 7대, 8대 from RIGHT to LEFT (rightmost = 초대, oldest); columns 초대 to 4대 are filled with faded names, the 5대 column (fifth from the right) is the highlighted current column with the heir's name "윤재림", and 6대 to 8대 are blank empty columns; no generation label is repeated or skipped; no other years or dates appear.

images.screen: B — 8대 뒤 결말: 마을 봉기 (1880년 동짓달)
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Same Korean head-house study at night, now in crisis. Left third: a tall latticed hanji paper sliding door glowing deep orange from torches outside, blurred silhouettes of villagers with torches, sickles and flails pressing against the paper, faint vertical shouted words showing through. Right two thirds: the hanji genealogy ledger fully written across eight generations in vertical right-to-left script, each column stamped with a small vermilion seal and several names struck through with straight vertical red brush lines; the final column ends in a spilled ink blot where the brush stopped. A huge rotated vermilion square seal is stamped across the page reading the ending. Red dashed debt threads converge from earlier generations into the last column. Bottom HUD strip of dark result chips, one glowing ember-red resentment meter at full. Palette: firelight orange, charred brown, cream paper, blood vermilion; flickering warm rim light, heavy vignette, film grain. Korean UI text: "마을 봉기", "원한 100", "버틴 대 4 / 8". Ledger constraints: the family surname is 윤 for every name; only four generation columns are written (초대, 2대, 3대, 4대, laid out right-to-left with 초대 rightmost), the ink blot ends the 4대 column, and the remaining 5대 to 8대 columns are left blank to match "버틴 대 4 / 8"; no years or dates appear.
